_README: ⚠️ THIS FILE CANNOT BE REGENERATED IDENTICALLY. DO NOT DELETE IT AS DERIVED DATA. It came from roughly 80 live Wikidata fetches across an eight-round fixpoint closure that resolved 3,725 class items, run on 2026-08-23. Wikidata has moved since. Re-running the fetch would produce a different model, and every count in ingredient_cuts.py and every threshold measured against it would shift. It is an INPUT to build_library.py, not an output of it.
_what: The anchor class QIDs for each kind, the priority order, the generic-food fallback set, and the hop cap.
_how: Hand-chosen after four iterations of the grouping. This is a JUDGEMENT, not a measurement.
_caveat: The order matters: the first anchor reached wins for that kind.
